headline: 今日影剧速递：热片领跑，热剧霸屏
summary: 今日影市由《保镖恋人》《魔法情缘》等热作领跑；剧集端《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续热播，待播《挑情丑闻》《完美的谎言》与待映《猫鼬》《生化危机：爆发夜》同步预热。

industryHighlights.text: 本周电影热作：《保镖恋人》《魔法情缘》《偷偷喜欢你》等领跑。
industryHighlights.en: This week's hot films: Bodyguard Lover, Magic Romance, Secretly Like You and more lead.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》等持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: Hit series: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon and more keep drawing viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧：《挑情丑闻》《完美的谎言》待上线。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming series: Scandalous Affair and Perfect Lie are set to launch.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《猫鼬》《生化危机：爆发夜》等预热。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Mongoose, Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and more build buzz.

headlineEn: Today's Screen Digest: Hot Films, Hit Series
summaryEn: Today's film market is led by Bodyguard Lover, Magic Romance and other hot titles; on TV, The Rookie, Rick and Morty and House of the Dragon stay popular, while upcoming series Scandalous Affair and Perfect Lie plus films Mongoose and Resident Evil: Outbreak Night build buzz.
